newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Raffles Medical Group gets listing approval.
newsitem.headline: Raffles Medical Group gets listing approval.

text.p: Healthcare company Raffles Medical Group Ltd (RMG) said on Monday it had received approval in principle for a listing on the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
The initial public offering of shares would raise funds to expand local operations and enable expansion around the region, said RMG in a statement.
It did not say how many shares it would offer or how much money it planned to raise.
Lead manager for the offering, expected to be launched in about a month, would be DBS Bank, the statement said.
RMG was established in 1976 and has an extensive clinic network providing primary and specialist services in Singapore.
The company opened its first overseas clinic in Hong Kong in December 1995 and is exploring opportunities in Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand, the statement said.
